```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6, dpi = 180, fig.path = "figures/", fig.align = "center")
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Data
runs = read.csv("data/all-attempts.csv")
requests = read.csv("data/request-stages.csv")
intervals = read.csv("trace/all-run-intervals.csv")
statistics = read.csv("data/group-statistics.csv")
phases = c("file_read_s", "tool_nonread_s", "harness_model_s")
phase_labels = c("File reads", "Tools excluding reads", "Harness + model + network")
arm_colors = c(A1 = "#2776B9", C1 = "#D77B35")
phase_colors = setNames(c("#27836C", "#2776B9", "#B8C2CC"), phase_labels)
summary = subset(statistics, metric %in% c("wall_s", "actual_calls"))
summary$arm = factor(summary$arm, c("C1", "A1"))
request_means = aggregate(requests[phases], requests[c("request", "arm")], mean)
stages = reshape(request_means, varying = phases, v.names = "seconds",
  timevar = "phase", times = phase_labels, direction = "long")
stages$phase = factor(stages$phase, phase_labels)
stages$arm = factor(stages$arm, c("C1", "A1"))
stages$request = paste("Request", stages$request)
request_means$total = rowSums(request_means[phases])
request_means$request = paste("Request", request_means$request)
v = sapply(c(phases, "wall_s"), function(m)
  mean(runs[runs$arm == "C1", m]) - mean(runs[runs$arm == "A1", m]))
waterfall = data.frame(label = c(phase_labels, "Net difference"), value = v,
  start = c(0, cumsum(v)[1:2], 0), end = c(cumsum(v)[1:3], v[4]), y = 4:1)
selected_trials = sapply(c("A1", "C1"), function(a) {
  z = runs[runs$arm == a, ]; z$trial[order(z$wall_s)][2]
})
timeline = do.call(rbind, lapply(names(selected_trials), function(a)
  subset(intervals, arm == a & trial == selected_trials[[a]])))
# Split tool activity at read boundaries; keep only its non-reading portions.
tools = subset(timeline, kind == "execution")
nonread = do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(tools)), function(i) {
  z = tools[i, ]; reads = subset(timeline, arm == z$arm & kind == "read")
  cuts = sort(unique(c(z$start, z$finish,
    pmax(z$start, pmin(z$finish, c(reads$start, reads$finish))))))
  a = head(cuts, -1); b = tail(cuts, -1); mid = (a + b) / 2
  keep = !vapply(mid, function(t) any(t >= reads$start & t < reads$finish), logical(1))
  out = z[rep(1, sum(keep)), ]; out$start = a[keep]; out$finish = b[keep]; out
}))
gantt = rbind(subset(timeline, kind != "execution"), nonread)
gantt$lane = c(request = 3, execution = 2, read = 1)[gantt$kind]
gantt$color = ifelse(gantt$kind == "request", arm_colors[gantt$arm],
  ifelse(gantt$kind == "read", phase_colors[1], phase_colors[2]))

# Tables and headline values
results_table = subset(statistics, metric %in% c("wall_s", "actual_calls",
  "r_execution_calls", "input_reads", "peak_gib"))
tokens_table = subset(statistics, grepl("tokens", metric))
reads_table = aggregate(input_reads ~ request + arm, requests,
  function(x) c(median = median(x), min = min(x), max = max(x)))
provenance = jsonlite::fromJSON("trace/provenance.json")
manifest = provenance$manifest
conditions = unlist(manifest[c("benchmark_version", "model", "reasoning_effort",
  "codex_version", "codex_r_execution_policy", "platform", "python")])
conditions_table = data.frame(condition = names(conditions), value = unname(conditions))
input_table = as.data.frame(manifest$dataset[c("input_format", "input_bytes", "spectra", "total_peaks")])
wall = tapply(runs$wall_s, runs$arm, median)
f = function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")
```

[Methods](method.md)

## A Total wall time and tool calls

**Median wall time: A1 `r f(wall[["A1"]])` s; C1 `r f(wall[["C1"]])` s.**
A1 takes `r f(wall[['C1']] - wall[['A1']])` seconds less, a `r f(100 * (1 - wall[['A1']] / wall[['C1']]))`% reduction relative to C1's median.
Each arm has three runs; we show the median, minimum, and maximum.
We show no confidence intervals and make no population-level significance claim.

```{r comparison, fig.height=7}
base_theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top",
  legend.title = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
  plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12))
comparison_plot = function(metric_name, title, axis_label) {
  z = subset(summary, metric == metric_name)
  ggplot(z, aes(x = median, y = arm, fill = arm)) +
    geom_col(width = .5) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = minimum, xend = maximum, yend = arm), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(x = minimum), shape = 124, size = 7) +
    geom_point(aes(x = maximum), shape = 124, size = 7) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, fill = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(x = maximum, label = sprintf("  %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", median, minimum, maximum)),
      hjust = 0, size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(z$maximum) * 1.65), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
    labs(title = title, x = axis_label, y = NULL) + base_theme + theme(legend.position = "none")
}
comparison_plot("wall_s", "Total wall time", "Seconds") /
  comparison_plot("actual_calls", "Actual tool calls", "Calls") +
  plot_annotation(subtitle = "Median [minimum, maximum] · Three runs per arm")
```

Wall time is in seconds; peak memory is in GiB.

```{r results-table}
results_table
```

C1 calls include commands, file edits, and polling; outer exec wrappers are not counted twice.

C1 polling waits for finite Rscript processes to finish.
A1 R executions count R tool calls; C1 R executions count separate Rscript processes.

## B Where does the time saving come from?

**File reads account for the main mean difference: C1 spends `r f(v[["file_read_s"]])` seconds more.**
Other tool activity and harness/model time together offset this by `r f(-sum(v[c("tool_nonread_s", "harness_model_s")]))` seconds.
The net mean difference is `r f(v[["wall_s"]])` seconds.

```{r request-stages, fig.height=7}
ggplot(stages, aes(seconds, arm, fill = phase)) +
  geom_col(width = .55, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(data = request_means, aes(total, arm, label = sprintf("  %.2f s", total)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  facet_grid(request ~ .) + scale_fill_manual(values = phase_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .18))) +
  labs(title = "Time per request", x = "Seconds · Mean of three runs", y = NULL) + base_theme
```

Each request has three non-overlapping time categories.
Stacked bars use means across three runs, so their parts sum to mean request time.

File reads include mzML opening, metadata parsing, peak decoding, and recorded result-table reads.
Other tool activity includes computation, output writing, and tool overhead.
The residual combines harness, model thinking, generation, and network waiting.

mzR peaks calls header internally; we take the union of all read intervals.
Finite C1 Rscript activity counts even when it spans multiple polling calls.
We allocate read time first, then other tool activity, then the residual.
The residual is not a separate measurement of model thinking time.

```{r signed-time, fig.height=4.5}
ggplot(waterfall) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#8799AA") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = pmin(start, end), xmax = pmax(start, end),
    ymin = y - .25, ymax = y + .25, fill = label)) +
  geom_segment(data = waterfall[1:2, ], aes(x = end, xend = end, y = y - .25, yend = y - .75),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "#8799AA") +
  geom_text(aes(x = pmax(start, end) + 5, y = y, label = sprintf("%+.2f s", value)), hjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(phase_colors, "Net difference" = arm_colors[["C1"]])) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 4:1, labels = waterfall$label) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(.02, .28))) +
  labs(title = "Where the time difference comes from", subtitle = "C1 minus A1 · Positive means C1 is slower",
    x = "Seconds · Difference between means", y = NULL) + base_theme + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Positive values mean C1 is slower; negative values mean C1 is faster.
This chart uses additive mean differences; Part A uses the difference between medians.
Startup, inter-request gaps, and cleanup belong to the whole-episode residual.
We do not assign time outside requests to individual requests.

## C Gantt chart and repeated reads

```{r gantt, fig.height=6.5}
ggplot(gantt) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = start, xmax = finish, ymin = lane - .25, ymax = lane + .25, fill = color)) +
  geom_segment(data = subset(gantt, kind == "execution" & finish - start < .4),
    aes(x = start, xend = start, y = lane - .25, yend = lane + .25), color = arm_colors[["A1"]]) +
  geom_segment(data = subset(gantt, kind == "request"),
    aes(x = start, xend = start, y = 2.75, yend = 3.25), color = "white", linewidth = .35) +
  geom_text(data = subset(gantt, kind == "request"),
    aes((start + finish) / 2, lane, label = paste0("R", request)), color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  facet_grid(arm ~ .) + scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("File reads", "Tools excl. reads", "Requests")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(.01, .02))) +
  labs(title = "Actual timeline of each arm's median-duration run",
    subtitle = "Green: reads · Blue: tools excluding reads · Thin ticks: short tool activity",
    x = "Seconds since run start", y = NULL) + base_theme
```

Representative runs: A1 trial `r selected_trials[["A1"]]` and C1 trial `r selected_trials[["C1"]]`.
Green bars show file reads; blue bars show tool activity excluding reads.
Intervals retain their actual durations. Short activities appear as thin ticks.
Overlapping tool activity is merged, so bar counts do not represent call counts.

The requests perform a full-load audit, an intensity summary, and a peak-count/base-peak summary.
Each request requires the complete spectra and peak arrays in R memory.
A1 can retain objects in memory; C1 uses finite native Rscript processes that exit after execution.
Both arms prohibit extra intermediate data and state caches on disk.
Scientific outputs comprise three small summary tables and one text report.

## D Tokens, conditions, and validation

```{r tokens-table}
tokens_table
```

Cached input tokens are a subset of input tokens; reasoning tokens are a subset of output tokens.
Token counts do not measure thinking time.

[MassIVE MSV000100943](https://massive.ucsd.edu/ProteoSAFe/dataset.jsp?task=39baaabaea894f3a9835e00a5e756431): one native plasma-proteomics mzML file (CC0).
Both arms ran on the same 16 GiB / 2 vCPU host.
Timing excludes input copying, downloads, and installation.
OS caches were not cleared; this is not a cold-disk benchmark.

```{r conditions-table}
conditions_table
input_table
```

**All six runs completed and passed numerical and execution-policy review.**
Review covered full-data scope, three result tables, scripts, artifacts, and execution traces for all six runs.
Independent full-data recomputation checked every requested summary at a tolerance of 1e-10.
This experiment adds no protein identification, clinical inference, or downstream biological analysis.

This benchmark measures full-file reading and memory reuse across requests.
Its results apply to this scenario, not to every task.

Input SHA256: `r manifest$dataset_sha256`.
Raw batch: `r provenance$run_id`.
